description: Managed device driver for Inogeni CAM Series HDMI/USB camera selectors, routing between USB 1, USB 2, HDMI, and test pattern.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: Inogeni header, stock Cognio controls.
Connect Offline replaces the Connect, Disconnect and Auto Connect buttons: online the driver always connects; offline it connects only while Connect Offline is on.

The driver now uses the IP address typed on the panel, Connected lights only after the camera answers, and a camera that stops answering is dropped and retried. The Standby button now sends the camera's allow-standby setting.
